meta.name: lcx-report-bug
meta.description: Create a high-signal bug issue or PR in the repo that owns the defect. Use this whenever the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when they need source-backed root cause, reproduction steps, fix guidance, and GitHub routing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动创建带根因分析和复现步骤的缺陷报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在GitHub仓库中提交高质量Bug Issue或修复PR。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically create bug reports with root cause analysis and reproduction steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to file high-signal bug issues or fix PRs in GitHub repos.

howto.what: 收到 bug 报告后，它会先核查最新源码和运行证据，判断该去哪个仓库报，再产出英文 issue（内容含复现步骤、根因、修复建议；openai/codex 可产 PR），并在 GitHub 创建或补充评论。
howto.when: 当你要求报告、提交或分类 LazyCodex、Codex 插件或 Codex CLI 等的 bug，或需要判断问题归哪个 GitHub 仓库时。

say.text: 把 Codex CLI 的报错写成 issue 发到 openai/codex
say.note: 它会先核实源码再创建。

say.text: 这个 LazyCodex 安装问题该报哪个仓库？拟个 bug 报告
say.note: 它会先判断归属再给报告。

say.text: 先搜 openai/codex 有无重复 issue，有就补证据
say.note: 有重复就评论补充，不新建。

howto.what_en: Claude re-checks latest sources and runtime evidence to route the bug to the owning repo, then writes an English GitHub issue (or openai/codex PR) with repro steps, root cause and fix guidance; duplicates get an evidence comment.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to report, file, or triage a bug in LazyCodex, Codex plugins, or upstream Codex CLI, or needs it routed to the right GitHub repo.

say_en.text: Turn this Codex CLI error into an openai/codex issue.
say_en.note: It verifies the sources first, then files it.

say_en.text: Which repo owns this LazyCodex install bug? Draft a report.
say_en.note: It routes the bug to the right repo and formats it.

say_en.text: Search openai/codex for a duplicate and add the new evidence.
say_en.note: It comments with the evidence instead of filing a duplicate.
